content:
Headquarters: Argentina

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing B2B sales professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Timezone: UK

Job Summary

We are searching for a Senior Product Designer for a remote product design role where you will own the full product design lifecycle—from discovery and user research to prototyping and final UI delivery. You’ll play a key role in shaping product strategy, improving user experience, and delivering elegant, scalable design solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design across web and/or mobile platforms
  • Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to inform design decisions
  • Translate complex product requirements into intuitive user experiences
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders
  • Contribute to and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries
  • Use data and user feedback to iterate and improve product performance
  • Advocate for user experience and design best practices across the organization
  • 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or similar roles
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design work
  • Expertise in tools like Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar
  • Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability principles
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams
  • Ability to balance business goals with user needs and technical constraints
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with SaaS or digital product environments is highly preferred
  • Basic understanding of front-end development (HTML/CSS/JS) is a plus

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/huzzle-senior-product-designer
